objects.original: Compact-state process on arbitrary compact pseudometric time, grids, energy sums and Taylor residuals.
objects.reconstructed: Define R_f(x,v)=f(x+v)-f(x)-Df(x)[v]-(1/2)*D^2 f(x)[v,v], where Df is the real Frechet derivative and D^2 f=D(Df), interpreted as iterated continuous linear maps. Put x_n,i(omega)=X(grid(n,i),omega) in K and v_n,i=x_n,i+1-x_n,i, understood as ambient vectors in E.
objects.evidence: AutoSamplingTheory/TechnicalLemmas/StochasticProcesses/ItoTaylorGridRemainder.lean: The exact residual body and endpoint differences are used; energy is a distinct supplied hypothesis.

domains.original: Finite sample measure, locally compact real normed E with Borel structure, compact K and compact pseudometric time T.
domains.reconstructed: Omega measurable with finite measure mu. E is a real normed additive group/normed vector space, locally compact, with a measurable structure equal to its Borel structure. T is an arbitrary compact pseudometric space. K is a compact subset of E; f:E->R; X:T x Omega->K; N:N->N; grid_n:{0,...,N(n)}->T; Q:Omega->R.
domains.evidence: AutoSamplingTheory/TechnicalLemmas/StochasticProcesses/ItoTaylorGridRemainder.lean: The T binder is a type with PseudoMetricSpace and CompactSpace, not a real horizon.

quantifiers.original: Mesh: every delta>0 eventually all neighboring cells are delta-close; energy converges to supplied finite real Q; then residual sum converges.
quantifiers.reconstructed: Universally spaces,instances,mu,K,hK,f,hf,X,hX,hpaths,N,grid,hmesh,Q,hQV. The mesh hypothesis has order forall delta>0, eventually n, forall i<N(n), dist(grid_n(i+1),grid_n(i))<delta. Q is fixed before the convergence premise.
quantifiers.evidence: AutoSamplingTheory/TechnicalLemmas/StochasticProcesses/ItoTaylorGridRemainder.lean: hmesh has forall delta>0,eventually n,forall i; N(n) need not tend to infinity.

assumptions.original: Ambient C² on K; measurable time evaluations; a.e. continuous paths; vanishing mesh and in-measure energy convergence.
assumptions.reconstructed: f is C^2 at every x in K in the ambient space E. Each slice X(t,.) is measurable. For mu-a.e. omega, t->X(t,omega) is continuous on all T. Adjacent grid distances tend uniformly over the finitely many cells to zero in the stated eventual sense. The sums sum_i ||v_n,i(omega)||^2 converge in mu-measure to Q(omega). No separate measurability of Q is written.
assumptions.evidence: AutoSamplingTheory/TechnicalLemmas/StochasticProcesses/ItoTaylorGridRemainder.lean: No convexity of K or global C² assumption is added; the compact Taylor lemma supplies a uniform increment radius internally.

conclusion.original: Signed sum of Taylor residuals converges in measure to zero.
conclusion.reconstructed: The real random variables sum_{i=0}^{N(n)-1} R_f(x_n,i(omega),v_n,i(omega)) converge in mu-measure to the identically zero function as n->infinity.
conclusion.evidence: AutoSamplingTheory/TechnicalLemmas/StochasticProcesses/ItoTaylorGridRemainder.lean: hRm makes sums measurable; the subsequence criterion, pathwise energy bound and compact residual estimate prove the limit.

scopes.original: No ordering/covering requirement on grids; only in-measure conclusion.
scopes.reconstructed: The remainder sum is signed, not the sum of absolute remainders. T need not be an interval; grids need not be ordered, cover T, or have designated endpoints, and N(n) is not required to tend to infinity. No convexity of K or global C^2 assumption on f is given. No almost-sure or L^p conclusion is asserted.
scopes.evidence: AutoSamplingTheory/TechnicalLemmas/StochasticProcesses/ItoTaylorGridRemainder.lean: Only adjacent distances are used in hstep; the proof never orders the time space.

constant_dependencies.original: No public estimate constant; proof uses path-dependent |Q|+1.
constant_dependencies.reconstructed: No explicit numerical constant is quantified in the conclusion. Any data-dependent estimates used to obtain it are not assumptions. Q may depend on the data but is just the supplied limiting random variable.
constant_dependencies.evidence: AutoSamplingTheory/TechnicalLemmas/StochasticProcesses/ItoTaylorGridRemainder.lean: C=|Q omega|+1 is positive and path-dependent; epsilon/(2C) is internal.
